description:
Section 73 Application to vary condition 6 (hours of operation) and 8 (Servicing and Delivery) of planning permission ref: P2023/2566/FUL dated 30 November 2023 which approved the following:

Change of use to the 3no. consented retail (Class A1/A3) units at ground floor and basement level to Class E floorspace and associated elevational amendments to the existing southern retail entrance.

The amendments include an extension to the permitted opening hours from 07:00-00:00 to 06:00-00:00 and servicing and deliveries to take place between 7am and 7pm each day.
decision_conditions:
AMALGAMATION:  The flexible Class E units on the ground and basement floors of the building shall not be amalgamated unless occupied by an SME, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 

REASON: The amalgamation of the commercial units is likely to have operational and amenity implications which would need to be considered under a separate planning application and to ensure the provision of premises suitable for small businesses.
